onboarding.headline: Access, manage, and stay in control — wherever you are.
onboarding.instructions:
On your Desktop:
Dentrooper 360 → register product → registration key
and scan the QR code available.

login.pairBeforeSignIn: Pair this device with a clinic QR code before signing in.
login.offlineHint: You need an internet connection to sign in. If you already have a saved session, open the app while offline from the splash screen.

feedback.signingInMessage: Please wait while we sign you in.
feedback.syncFailedMessage: Unable to finish preparing your clinic data.
feedback.successMessage: Your app is ready to open.
feedback.preparingMessage: Syncing clinic data with the server.

error.generic: Unable to sign in. Check your credentials and try again.
error.pairRequired: Pair this device with a clinic before signing in.

qr.invalidMessage: The scanned QR code is not a valid registration code.
qr.pairingMessage: Registering this device with your clinic.
qr.pairedMessage: Your device has been registered successfully.
qr.pairedAddClinicMessage: Clinic paired. Sign in with that clinic’s credentials to continue.
qr.failedMessage: Unable to register your device. Please check the QR code and try again.

splash.unableSync: Unable to sync clinic data. Check your connection and try again.
splash.unableSyncContinue: Unable to sync right now. You can continue with previously synced clinic data.
